source: https://uppbpb.gov.in/Home/Notice: Advertisement 07/2025 (Direct Recruitment 2025, dated 31 December 2025) subject-wise syllabus; topic lists cross-checked with dated summaries at adda247.com/exams/up/up-police-constable-syllabus/ and testbook.com
intro: One offline OMR paper of 150 questions for 300 marks in 2 hours, with four subjects, no sectional timing and 0.5 negative marking for wrong answers.
note: The topic lists follow the subject-wise syllabus in the board's Advertisement 07/2025. The OMR sheet comes in three copies: the original goes to the board and you keep a copy.

sections.name: General Knowledge (सामान्य ज्ञान)
topics: History, culture and art of India with a heavy Uttar Pradesh slant: UP's history, architecture, festivals, fairs, folk dances and literature
Geography of India and Uttar Pradesh: rivers, soil, climate, natural resources, forests and wildlife
Indian economy and the economy of Uttar Pradesh, agriculture, industry and development schemes
Indian Constitution and polity: Preamble, fundamental rights and duties, panchayati raj, public administration and good governance
Current affairs, national and international, and major awards and sports events
Human rights and their protection
Internal security and law and order: terrorism, left-wing extremism, organised crime, narcotics and cyber crime
Population, environment and urbanisation, with emphasis on Uttar Pradesh
Basic science and everyday technology
sections.tip: UP-specific questions carry real weight here, so revise UP history, geography and current schemes separately from national GK.

sections.name: General Hindi (हिंदी)
topics: हिंदी वर्णमाला और वर्तनी (spelling)
व्याकरण: संधि, समास, उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय
पर्यायवाची और विलोम शब्द
अनेकार्थी शब्द और तत्सम-तद्भव
मुहावरे और लोकोक्तियाँ
वाक्य शुद्धि: अशुद्ध वाक्यों को शुद्ध करना, व्याकरणिक त्रुटियाँ
अपठित गद्यांश (unseen passage): बोध और प्रश्न
वाक्य विच्छेद और वाक्य रचना

sections.name: Numerical & Mental Ability (संख्यात्मक एवं मानसिक योग्यता)
topics: Number system, LCM and HCF
Percentage, profit and loss, discount
Simple and compound interest
Ratio and proportion, average, mixture
Time and work, pipes and cisterns
Time, speed and distance, trains and boats
Mensuration: area, perimeter and volume of basic figures
Basic algebra and geometry at the Class 10 level
Data interpretation: tables, bar graphs and charts
Mental ability: number and letter series, odd one out, missing numbers

sections.name: Mental Aptitude Test / IQ / Reasoning (मानसिक अभिरुचि, बुद्धिलब्धि एवं तार्किक क्षमता)
topics: Mental aptitude (मानसिक अभिरुचि परीक्षण): public interest, law and order, communal harmony, discipline, character and integrity, interest in the police job, sensitivity towards minorities and weaker sections, adaptability
Decision making: everyday situations calling for a judgment between options
IQ: analogies, classification, series completion, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, mathematical operations, Venn diagrams
Verbal reasoning: syllogism, statement and conclusion, statement and assumption, ranking and order
Non-verbal reasoning: mirror images, paper folding and cutting, embedded figures, space visualisation
sections.tip: Decision-making sets are a UP Police favourite, so practise these sets specifically.
